panels.caption: Every Arena opens. One hundred and twenty skies turn into a single flower above Astral Plains.

panels.text: Across all 120 islands, every Arena opens at the same moment.
The final score crosses worlds. One celebration becomes 120 celebrations, synchronized into a single field of light.
The Arena network gives Navigation its first complete measurement of the expedition's route.
The route resolves into a spiral. The destination has not moved.
The stars did not move. We did.
